Federico Viticci explored how Claude’s new “save as Mac app” feature works. It reminds me of ChatGPT Sites more than Mac apps, just in terms of how it’s tied to the AI company’s infrastructure: …entirely bypassing the App Store or Apple’s notarization system for apps distributed outside the App Store, and by creating their own lock-in system around Claude’s identity and capabilities instead.
